entities.name: Network initiated detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the network initiates detach by sending a DETACH REQUEST message to the UE, starting timer T3422, and handling security context and EPS bearer contexts based on detach type and EMM cause.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate the detach procedure. It may include an EMM cause IE and detach type IE.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to accept the detach request, which stops timer T3422.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: IE included in DETACH REQUEST to specify the reason for detach. Values include #2 'IMSI unknown in HSS' and #78 'PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location'.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: IE indicating whether re-attach is required or not required, influencing security context handling and state transitions.

entities.name: T3422
entities.description: Timer started by the network upon sending DETACH REQUEST and stopped upon receiving DETACH ACCEPT.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by the network after sending DETACH REQUEST with specific detach type and EMM cause conditions.

entities.name: Detach type indicates re-attach and EMM cause not #2
entities.description: Condition where detach type is 're-attach required' or 're-attach not required' and EMM cause is not #2 'IMSI unknown in HSS'.

entities.name: Store native EPS security context
entities.description: Behavior where the MME stores the current EPS security context if it is native, performed under specific detach conditions.

entities.name: Delete mapped EPS security context
entities.description: Behavior where the MME deletes the current EPS security context if it is mapped, performed under specific detach conditions.

entities.name: Deactivate EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Behavior where the network deactivates EPS bearer contexts locally for the UE under specific detach conditions.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the DETACH REQUEST message.
DETACH REQUEST may include the EMM cause IE.
DETACH REQUEST includes the detach type IE.
The procedure starts timer T3422 upon sending DETACH REQUEST.
Receiving DETACH ACCEPT stops timer T3422.
Condition leads to storing native EPS security context.
Condition leads to deleting mapped EPS security context.
Condition leads to deactivating EPS bearer contexts.
Condition leads to entering state EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED.
Detach type IE values guard the condition for re-attach and EMM cause not #2.
EMM cause IE value guards the condition for not being #2.
